subject: Acme SOC 2 evidence & DPA - Post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery call follow-up / SOC 2 scope

Marissa — thanks again for the call today. Quick notes from my side and a couple of clarifying questions before I share with our security team:

- Primary goal: ensure any vendor storing request/response data can provide audit logs, retention controls, and a DPA that meets our legal team requirements.
- Pain points: previous vendor had inconsistent audit log exports, and we need stronger retention/archiving controls (30/90/365 day tiers).
- Compliance ask: do you have a SOC 2 Type II? Can you provide the report and any pen-test summaries?

Action items for Redwood: share SOC 2 artifacts (redacted ok), DPA draft, and a sample audit log export so our SREs can validate schema. Also need to know where evidence will be hosted — secure link preferred.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Smith
Director, Security Operations
Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up / SOC 2 scope — Post-call recap + next steps

Jane — great meeting, appreciate the clarity. Recap below and proposed next steps (aiming to keep this lightweight for your security and legal teams):

Recap of what we heard
- Goals: audited, auditable inference platform with exportable audit logs, configurable retention, and a DPA that meets Acme legal controls.
- Pain points: inconsistent audit exports, lack of clear retention tiers, and need for pen-test evidence for vendor assessment.

What Redwood can provide (summary)
- SOC 2 Type II (2025) — full report available; we'll provide a redacted copy for upload.
- Penetration test summary & remediation notes (2025) — summary PDF attached; full details available under NDA.
- Audit logs: sample CSV export showing request_id, timestamp, model_id, route, token_count, and redaction flags (attached sample). Exports can be configured for daily/weekly/monthly buckets.
- Retention controls: configurable retention policies at 30/90/365 days for request-level logs; option to set longer archival retention for enterprise contracts.
- Encryption & access controls: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit, granular RBAC, and integration with customer-managed KMS for Private deployments.
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA draft (redwood-dpa-draft.docx). We are open to a one-off redline; if you prefer, we can coordinate with our legal team (cc'd: Rishi).

Proposed next steps & owners
1) Marissa (me) — Upload redacted SOC 2 Type II report and pen-test summary to secure Drive link by EOD Feb 13. (attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf)
2) Dev Patel — Share a sample audit-log export and a short README of schema and retention options by Feb 13. (attachment: audit-logs-sample.csv)
3) Rishi Malhotra (Legal) — Stand by for DPA redline coordination. If Acme shares redlines, we can turn around within 3 business days.
4) Jane / Acme — Confirm the preferred upload method (secure Drive link vs. S3 presigned vs. DocuSign for DPA) and any specific redaction requirements.

If that all looks right I'll proceed with the uploads and loop in our Security Ops Slack channel for any technical questions.

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
From: Brian Lee <brian.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 18:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up / SOC 2 scope — quick questions

Marissa / Jane — quick follow-ups from our info security review: 

1) SOC 2: we prefer the full report (redacted PANs) and the auditor's letter. Can you confirm the auditor firm and scope (CC1/CC2 controls covered)?
2) Pen test: summary is OK for initial review; for procurement we'll need the date and remediation status.
3) Audit logs: can you include example logs showing user_id (hashed), request_id, timestamps, and retention metadata? Does the export include full response bodies or are those redacted by default?
4) DPA: we'll upload our redline to DocuSign if you prefer; otherwise send as a Word doc and we'll redline offline.

Platform questions: Does Redwood offer a VPC/private deployment for regulated workloads (we may need customer-managed KMS)? Also, are there guaranteed retention SLAs?

Thanks,
Brian
Brian Lee
Senior Security Engineer, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acme.com>, Brian Lee <brian.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up / SOC 2 scope — evidence upload + next steps

Brian / Jane — thanks for the quick notes. Confirming answers and next steps below: 

Answers
- Auditor firm & scope: SOC 2 Type II (period Jan-Dec 2025) audited by Clearpath Auditing LLP; scope includes security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality (CC1-CC4). I will include the auditor letter in the upload.
- Pen test: conducted Nov 2025; summary attached, all high findings remediated as documented in the remediation_notes section. Full report available under NDA.
- Audit logs: sample export attached (audit-logs-sample.csv). By default, response bodies are redacted for PII; logs include hashed user_id, request_id, model_id, timestamp, route, and retention_flag. We can enable full-body exports under an enterprise contract with additional controls.
- DPA: attaching our Word DPA draft; happy to take your redlines via DocuSign link or direct upload. Rishi will be primary for legal follow-up.
- Private deployment / KMS: yes — Redwood Private supports VPC, on-prem, and customer-managed KMS. We can share deployment architecture and KMS integration docs if helpful.
- Retention SLAs: standard config supports 30/90/365-day tiers; for contractual SLAs we can add explicit retention and archive guarantees in Dedicated/Private deals.

Planned uploads (by EOD Feb 13)
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf (redacted) — uploaded to shared Drive link
- pen-test-summary.pdf — uploaded to same Drive
- audit-logs-sample.csv — attached to this thread
- redwood-dpa-draft.docx — attached / DocuSign link available on request

Next steps (owners & timelines)
- Action: I will upload the materials to the Drive link and send you access. (Owner: Marissa, ETA: EOD Feb 13)
- Action: Dev will prepare a short tech brief on retention and export options and will be available for an SRE call next week. (Owner: Dev Patel, ETA: Feb 16)
- Action: Acme to confirm preferred DPA process (DocuSign vs Word redline) and share any immediate redlines. (Owner: Acme security/legal)

If you'd like, I can set up a 30-minute follow-up with Dev and our security lead next week to walk through the audit log schema and retention controls.

Best,
Marissa
